_comment: score_small2 and smolgguf2 are the reruns of score_small (the live model at T 256 has PIQA solutions longer than its context: now chance credit, counted) and smolgguf (two pip installs at once; now serialised). Standard small benchmarks and IF-tiny (LOCAL_LLM_STACK.md section 11, items 5.2 and 3; experiments/benchmarks_2026-10-26/), one RunPod L4, two jobs at a time on the one GPU. items: tools/bench_build.py fetches the pinned files (experiments/benchmarks_2026-10-26/sources.json) and checks the item file's sha256. score_small / score_pk: tools/bench_eval.py with the CUDA mtstudio score (log-prob forced choice; BLiMP 100 pairs per paradigm). hf_ref: the same items through HF transformers float32 on Pythia-160m and SmolLM2-135M (sanity anchors). iftiny: ember fe01b35 with EMBER_DETERMINISTIC=1 (gated by ember 26 Oct 2026, receipts ember df43463: run to run bit-identical on one GPU model and build; EMBER_GEMM_TF32=0) serves each model's GGUF, exported here from the uploaded safetensors with mtstudio export (sha256s in staged.jsonl), IF-tiny v1 and the turn-distance set v1, two passes, mtstudio parity. iftiny_hf: the IF sets through HF generate on SmolLM2-135M-Instruct and Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct. smolgguf: SmolLM2-135M at its pinned revision converted to an F32 GGUF with llama.cpp b6000's convert_hf_to_gguf.py, for ember's /score gate. Uploads: TAG.safetensors for pksft, pkbase, live, pick_e1_L16, pick_e1_L32, pick_pilot_s35; vocab_llama3_bpe.gguf; tinychat_bpe8k.gguf.
